# Field notes

Help inspectors record observations at a site and review them later.
An observation is one dated note attached to a site.
The owner has approved the product goal.

One decision remains unresolved: must inspectors work without network access?
If yes, use an offline mobile app with local storage and later synchronisation.
If no, use a browser app backed by a server database.
Do not choose either stack until the owner resolves offline access.
